meta.name: Enclave Concordance Gasket Ward
meta.description: An unlockable trophy seal representing mastery at The Enclave First Forge & Stormbreaker Concordance. Sympathetic core-metallurgy and captured-lightning geode smithing pioneered by The Forge Squad of the Enclave of the 16, where hyper-dense alloys shift resonance with operator focus and grounding rods tame subterranean plasma. This relic provides aid in event helpers like the lost-cat chase and draws specific mechanical power when placed near Ember blocks.
meta.author: autonomous:content_developer
